title: PL4G diagnostic catalog
description: The definitive, implementation-independent collection of the errors and warnings the PL4G compiler emits.  spec/spec.md requires that these numbers be unique, constant and consistent between implementations so that code can react to them.

blocks.description: The partitioning of the four-digit number space.  Related diagnostics stay numerically adjacent; unrelated families are separated by reserved gaps.

number.description: The stable identity of a diagnostic.  Never reused, never changed -- not even when a warning is promoted to an error.

name.description: Symbolic name derived from the location of the violated requirement in the specification.  LANG_ prefixes requirements from spec/spec.md, IMPL_ those from spec/details.md.

specref.description: Back-reference to the requirement this diagnostic enforces.  The requirement is quoted verbatim so that drift between specification and implementation is visible.

argument.description: A declared placeholder of the message text.  Declaring them lets a self-test verify that message and args agree.

message.description: One-line message.  Placeholders use str.format syntax and must match the declared args exactly.

cause.description: The fuller description of the potential sources of the problem that spec/details.md asks for.

internal.description: True for internal compiler errors, which report a compiler defect rather than a defect in the compiled program.

option.description: Name used with -W and -Wno- to control this diagnostic.  Null when it cannot be controlled.

notes.description: Symbolic names of note-severity diagnostics this one may attach.
